A required SecretRef left out is a 400. Each SecretRef is still checked against the write-side rules, so a kind this server cannot resolve (kubernetes_secret) or a ManagedSecret that no longer exists is a 400."

  path={"/v1/gateways/{gateway_id}/connectors/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}

</MethodEndpoint>



Full replace: resend every mutable field. To keep a connector's secrets, send the auth object a GET returned back unchanged; the read renders each SecretRef, never a secret value. An optional SecretRef left out of the body (token_exchange client_secret, xaa idp_client_secret and target_client_secret) is cleared, which turns a confidential client into a public one. A required SecretRef left out is a 400. Each SecretRef is still checked against the write-side rules, so a kind this server cannot resolve (kubernetes_secret) or a ManagedSecret that no longer exists is a 400.
